hook.line: There are three types of content you should post: TOFU, MOFU and BOFU.
hook.visual: Three stacked copies of the same creator labelled TOFU/MOFU/BOFU with 1M/100K/10K view tags; lime 'What's the DIFFERENCE?' text.

beats.what: Three stacked rows of her, labelled TOFU, MOFU, BOFU with view counts
Lime funnel graphic fills the top tier: top of funnel content
Grid of view counts (1M, 1.6M, 3.7M) proves 'more views'
Phone screenshot of leads for the bottom tier: 'more leads'
Example thumbnail and 'Tier List Videos' label for TOFU
Thumbnail collage 'About Personal' stories for MOFU
'Fake Case Study Videos' example for BOFU
All three rows show thumbnail strips: 'depending on your goals'
Ends on 'of all these 3 types' with the strips still up

why_it_works: The three-row layout is the structure: each version of her talks in her own tier, so the framework is visible without a diagram.
View tags (1M, 100K, 10K) on each row make the trade-off concrete at a glance.
Example thumbnails appear beside the row that is talking, so each content type gets proof.
Fast speech (4 words/s) and no pauses suit a dense list people save (2,581 shares).
weaknesses: Each row is small (face about 11% of frame height), so expression is lost.
Overlay text is tiny and hard to read on a phone.
No spoken CTA; the follow ask is only in the caption.
for_robert: Stack the same take in rows (or let Fred take one row) to show a 3-part framework as a layout, with a number tag per row. Keep text larger.
